notes: Validated against Serganov, Huang & Patel, Nature 2009 (doi:10.1038/nature07642). FMN isoalloxazine ring intercalates between A48 (below) and A85 (above), providing continuous stacking alignment linking helices P6 and P3. Uracil-like edge of isoalloxazine forms Watson-Crick-like H-bonds with A99. FMN phosphate contacts conserved guanosines G10, G11, G32, G84 via H-bonds; also direct and Mg2+-mediated phosphate contacts. Mg ion M1 directly coordinates FMN phosphate oxygen and G33 N7.
